methods.boundary_attribution: geoBoundaries / William & Mary geoLab; see boundary metadata
methods.area_method: Brazil-centred Lambert azimuthal equal-area, clipped original cells
methods.time_method: Each calendar-month climatology is weighted by model-day count across 20 years. Selected-month means pool these day weights. pr and tran remain rates in mm/day.
methods.scope: All retained Brazil boundary area, not an Amazon-only or forest-only mask.
methods.precision: Monthly native climatologies encoded with 8 significant digits; national values derived from that same table.
